biography: Felipe Baptista's journey began amidst the vibrant chaos of São Paulo, Brazil, where the roar of engines was as common as the samba beat. His father, a mechanic with a passion for go-karts, introduced him to the world of racing at the tender age of six. Weekends were spent tearing around dusty karting tracks, a baptism by fire that forged Felipe's aggressive, never-back-down style. A defining moment came at the Brazilian Karting Championship when, despite starting last after a mechanical failure, he clawed his way to victory, showcasing the raw talent and relentless determination that would become his trademarks. Moving into Formula Renault, then touring cars, Baptista quickly caught the eye of KTF Sports. Now, in what many consider his peak years, Baptista is a force to be reckoned with, constantly pushing the limits of both himself and his machine. Despite some setbacks, his determination has seen him rise through the ranks, now competing for podiums in top-tier GT racing, often finding himself in the thick of it with the best.
drivingStyle: Baptista is known for his aggressive, attacking style. He's a late-braker who isn't afraid to throw the car into a corner, often flirting with the edge of grip. While this approach can lead to spectacular overtakes, it also occasionally results in costly mistakes. He's a master of tire management, however, able to extract maximum performance from his rubber late in a stint when others are struggling. Under pressure, Baptista tends to thrive, his focus sharpening and his determination intensifying.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision during the 24 Hours of Daytona that cost Baptista the win. The bad blood has lingered ever since.
A fierce on-track battle for the GT World Championship in 2023, characterized by numerous close calls and aggressive maneuvers. The rivalry is intense, but respectful.
A clash of generations. Tanaka, a young upstart, accused Baptista of overly aggressive tactics after being punted off track during a crucial race, sparking a heated exchange in the media.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks (unwashed) on race day.
Listens to a specific playlist of Brazilian samba music before every race to get into the zone.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his steering wheel with a microfiber cloth before each session, regardless of how clean it already is.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser. If you're not pushing to win, what's the point?
careerHighlight: Winning the Spa 24 Hours in 2022 with KTF Racing, overcoming a series of mechanical issues and a late-race safety car to snatch victory in the final laps.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Brazilian GT Championship race in 2021, handing the title to his rival and suffering a broken collarbone in the process.
